summary: Navy Trust polish pass (iter 12) — frontend-only regression validated via Playwright. All three targeted refinements pass: (1) /register split-navy layout renders correctly with aside visible at lg (1920x1080) — all 9 register testids resolve, VENDOR/BUYER toggle correctly swaps bg-brand-navy-soft styling; (2) /vendor/profile new chip-based stepper resolves — data-testid=vendor-stepper is a 6-row list, all vp-step-1..6 resolve, active step 1 has bg-brand-pale + navy-soft left border, past steps show ✓ chips after navigating forward, clicking each step navigates correctly (step 3→bank form, step 6→signature form); (3) /tenders/{id} new header pills + rail cards all resolve — tender-doctype-pill shows 'RFP' in caps, tender-status pill inside main card, font-display serif title present. Right rail cards verified across 4 tender types: rail-budget (with fx-chip FX conversion to KZT), rail-deadline (with tender-countdown showing '9d 23h 11m'), rail-emd shows 'USD 1,000' on EMD tender, rail-two-envelope on two-envelope RFP, rail-licenses on KZ tender lists 'Electrical installation'. Spot-check of all previously verified testids (landing, buyer nav, admin nav) confirms every testid still resolves. Landing bug from iter 11 (vendors_total→vendors_approved) is FIXED — stat-vendors now correctly renders '36'. Frontend log tail shows only 'Compiled successfully!' repeatedly; older react-hooks warnings in log are stale (from earlier compile cycles when @/pages/VendorKpi/AdminSbd were mid-move) — current TenderDetail.jsx L52 & L1055 useEffect calls both carry eslint-disable-line comments.

register.toggle-vendor→buyer: OK — bg-brand-navy-soft moves to buyer, vendor loses it

vendor_profile.past-step-checkmark: OK — vp-step-1 shows ✓ after navigating to step 6

tender_detail_emd.rail-emd: FOUND text='EMD required USD 1,000 Refunded automatically to losing bidders on award.'

compile_health.note: Stale react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings in older log entries are from earlier compile cycles (during @/pages/VendorKpi + @/pages/AdminSbd module moves). Current TenderDetail.jsx L52 (`useEffect(load, [id, user?.role])`) and L1055 (`useEffect(load, [tender.id])`) both carry `// eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`. No active warnings in latest compile cycle.

critical_code_review_comments: TenderDetail.jsx header now correctly has doctype-pill + status pill inside the main card (L86–91). Redundant `data-testid=tender-doctype` still exists in the DashboardLayout `actions` slot (L73) alongside `tender-detail-status` — both are duplicates of the new pills inside the card. Not a bug, but consider removing the header-actions duplicates in a future pass to reduce visual noise on the top-right of the page (they compete with the fresh doctype-pill inside the card body).

VendorProfile stepper renders 'Section D/E' as `Section D/E` (from the STEPS array) — visually OK but the slash between D and E might merit a middle-dot for consistency with the rest of the design system (e.g. `Section D · E`). Cosmetic only.

Register.jsx: form submit correctly wires to `useAuth().register()` which POSTs to `/api/auth/register` (unchanged from prior iterations). Split-navy layout uses the shared /hero-containers.jpg image with 30% opacity + navy gradient overlay — matches the Login split panel.
FxChip persists chosen target currency to localStorage under `pmc.fx.target` — nice UX detail preserved.
No console errors during navigation beyond expected 401s on `/api/auth/me` while logged out.
Compile is clean; SSE stream at /api/feed/stream is still up so any future Playwright authors must use `wait_until='domcontentloaded'` + explicit selector waits (not `networkidle`).
